op-plan.shape: interface OpPlan { op: Operation; http:{verb:HttpVerb;route:string}; mcp:{name:string}; cli:{path:string[]}; grpc:{package:string;service:string;method:string}; params?: ParamInfo[]; envelope: Array<{field:string;pluginId:string;httpHeader:string;mcpMetaKey:string;cliFlag:string;envVar:string}>; cliFlags: Map<string,{camelKey:string;kind:'domain'|'envelope';valueKind:'boolean'|'json'|'string'}>; streaming:boolean; isMount:boolean; mountHandler?:(call:Call)=>unknown|Promise<unknown>|AsyncIterable<unknown> }  // computed once per op; envelope[] and cliFlags derived from the composed input schema (proposal §3a)

transport-adapter.shape: interface TransportAdapter<Raw=unknown> { registerRoute(plan:OpPlan, dispatch:(call:Omit<Call,'operation'|'ctx'>)=>Promise<unknown>|AsyncIterable<unknown>):void; readCall(raw:Raw, plan:OpPlan):Omit<Call,'operation'|'ctx'>|Promise<Omit<Call,'operation'|'ctx'>>; writeResult(raw:Raw, result:unknown|AsyncIterable<unknown>, plan:OpPlan):void|Promise<void>; writeError(raw:Raw, err:unknown, plan:OpPlan):void|Promise<void> }  // Raw stays a generic escape hatch (SSE needs reply.hijack); read/write are genuinely transport-specific (proposal §3c)
